label: 6. Hey, Brid? Are you at work?

lines.text: Hey, Brid? Are you at work?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Hi, Commander.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I apologize for the late response.
I hope I'm not disturbing you when you're busy.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Not at all. I just completed some urgent tasks,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: and now I'm having a quick coffee break.
That's nice.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Did you need something?
I'm just checking in to see if you're getting enough rest.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I've actually been taking the

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: occasional coffee break.
Glad to hear that.
Does drinking coffee count as taking a break?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I appreciate your concern.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: For me, it's the best way to relax

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: since it also improves my efficiency for my next task.
Sounds like you're a real coffeeholic.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: There's such a wide variety of beans

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: that you can select one tailored to your mood each day.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: In an attempt to diversity my coffee experience,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I've been testing out new brewing methods.
Like what?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: First, you've got coffee pod machines.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: A machine channels boiling water through a small capsule packed with compressed powder.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: With that, it extracts strong flavored coffee in mere seconds.
That must produce a rich flavor.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Yes, it does.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It's also convenient to drink when I'm busy,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: so it's the method I use the most.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Having said that,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: the best coffee are ones that require time and effort,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: like siphon coffee.
Siphon coffee? What's that?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: this method utilizes steam from below as a heat source

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: to extract the coffee.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It's quite enjoyable and feels like you're conducting a science experiment.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Above all else, the taste is incomparable.
Interesting.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: And recently, I purchased a new device.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It uses a modified version of a rocket engine cylinder,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: and the name is absolutely stellar.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It's called a Space Rocket Coffee Maker.
Is that actually a real thing?
Is it safe?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It sure is.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It may be a bit over the top just for making a cup of coffee,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: but it really does provide you

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: with a bold and powerful cup of java.
Now, you've got me curious.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If you like, you can come over and try some.
I'll be right there.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
